title: Push registration
summary: No screen of its own: keeps this phone registered with Bipe's push gateway (Sygnal at push.bipe.net.br) so the homeserver can wake the app. The push carries only the event and room IDs, never the content.

status.description: off: no permission, notifications off on this phone, or no push token. registered: the pusher is set for the current token.

pushToken.description: APNs device token (iOS) or FCM token (Android). Kept on the device.

register.effect: On a granted permission, a new token or an app start with notifications on: Client.setPusher with an HTTP pusher (url https://push.bipe.net.br/_matrix/push/v1/notify, format EventIdOnly), the platform app ID, the app name Bipe, the device name, and lang from the app language; append false.

unregister.effect: When the person turns notifications off on this phone or signs out: Client.deletePusher with the same identifiers.

notes: Push app IDs stay the forks' IDs so Sygnal needs no change (client-rewrite-plan.md section 7): on iOS the four IDs Sygnal lists, chat.bipe.app[.dev].ios.dev|prod, picked by bundle ID and APNs environment (bipe/docs/server-migration.md). Android uses FCM through Sygnal once the Firebase project exists (bipe-chat/bipe#89).
PushFormat EventIdOnly is required (security.md: push carries no content). Never send a pusher with the full event format.
Apple (APNs) and Google (FCM) see only a code, not the message (linguagem.md: what we can promise). product/data.json already lists both.
Re-register after each token change; the platforms rotate tokens.
